title: WorkflowSeedContext
description: Reference definitions (not an artifact kind, no manifest entry, no single root object to validate) for context assumed to be available as independently-seeded workflow variables — never nested under one combined wrapper. 'company' (see definitions.company below) is seeded as tnsw/trade/trade_workflow.json's own top-level variable named 'traderCompany' (see trade_1_cha_selection's input_mapping); it crosses into tnsw/trade/3-prepare_split_items's build_split_items node as local var 'company', which HSCODE_SPLIT_BUILDER bakes into each split item; inside a SPLIT_TASK-spawned agency flow (e.g. tnsw/npqs/npqs_workflow.json's n1_apply) it's read back out at '_iter.input.company.<field>' — '_iter' being the current split-task iteration context and '.input' that item's own input payload. 'cha' (see definitions.cha) is read the same way at '_iter.input.cha.<field>'. See .claude/skills/autofill-global-context/SKILL.md for how to wire a new field into a workflow.

company.description: The registered trader company a workflow (or a spawned agency workflow) is running on behalf of. Shape confirmed directly from a real sample payload (2026-09-08) — see per-field notes below for anything inferred rather than directly confirmed.

id.description: Company id in the trader-registry service, e.g. 'adam-pvt-ltd'. Note: this exact value also appears as the example for trade-cha-selection-flow's 'cha_company_id' x-search field (tnsw/trade/1-cha_selection/userinput_jsonform.json) — suggestive that CHAs and trader companies may share this same id space/registry, but that's an observation, not a confirmed fact.

name.description: Company display name, e.g. 'ADAM PVT LTD'. There is only one name field, but the same source key can be mapped to more than one destination field within a single input_mapping (with or without the trailing '?') — e.g. tnsw/npqs/npqs_workflow.json's n1_apply node maps '_iter.input.company.name?' to both 'applicant_name' and 'exporter_name'. Add a distinctly-named field here only if a genuinely separate value (not just a different label) is confirmed to exist.

ouHandle.description: Organizational-unit handle. Equal to 'id' in the one confirmed sample seen so far ('adam-pvt-ltd') — exact relationship to 'id' (always identical vs. coincidence) is not confirmed.

hasCha.description: Meaning not fully confirmed. Most likely: whether this company currently has a CHA associated with it (e.g. to decide whether tnsw/trade/1-cha_selection should default-select one). Verify the exact semantics before branching or autofilling logic on it.

createdAt.description: When this company record was created, e.g. '2026-09-08T14:00:53.413612+05:30'.

updatedAt.description: When this company record was last updated.

data.description: Registry attributes about the company. The address is 'data.address' below, not a top-level company field.

br_no.description: Sri Lanka business registration (BR) number, e.g. 'PV-00123456'.

tin_no.description: Tax Identification Number, e.g. '134256789'. It is the Customs exporter code: tnsw/customs/customs_workflow.json's customs_1_cusdec_submission prefills the CusDec's exporter code (Box 2, traders.exporter.code) from it, as it does the declarant code from the CHA's.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email on file for the company, e.g. 'info@adam-pvt-ltd.lk' (nsw-srilanka's configs/companies.example.json). tnsw/trade/trade_workflow.json's trade_1_cha_selection, tnsw/slpa/slpa_workflow.json's slpa_1_0_ecdn, tnsw/cda/2-king-coconut-fresh-nuts-recommendation/cda_workflow.json's cda_kcfn_1_0_apply and tnsw/cda/3-kernel-products-asycuda-approval/cda_workflow.json's cda_1_0_apply read it. A company record without it leaves those fields empty.

address.description: The company's address on one line, e.g. 'No. 45, Galle Road, Colombo 03, Sri Lanka' (nsw-srilanka's configs/companies.example.json). The record also carries 'address2'–'address4', empty in every example company, which no mapping reads. tnsw/fcau/fcau_workflow.json's fcau_1_0_apply, tnsw/customs/customs_workflow.json's customs_1_cusdec_submission, tnsw/slpa/slpa_workflow.json's slpa_1_0_ecdn and tnsw/cda/1-export-coconut-certificate-registration/cda_workflow.json's cda_1_0_apply read it.

agencies.description: Per-regulatory-agency data about this company, keyed by agency slug (cda/customs/fcau/npqs/sltb, per CLAUDE.md's agency list). Each agency's object shape is agency-specific — there's no shared sub-schema, since what one agency tracks about a registrant has nothing to do with what another does. Only 'cda' and 'npqs' are modeled so far; add a sibling property here (and wire it the same way, via that agency's own macro workflow) when another agency needs its own company-level data. Placement under 'data' (alongside br_no/tin_no/vat_no) is a best-fit guess for consistency with the rest of this object, not yet confirmed against the real payload — move it if the actual data lands elsewhere.

registration_number.description: This company's 4-digit CDA Exporter Identification Number. Two CDA applications open with it filled: tnsw/cda/1-export-coconut-certificate-registration/cda_workflow.json's cda_1_0_apply (exporter_registration_number) and tnsw/cda/2-king-coconut-fresh-nuts-recommendation/cda_workflow.json's cda_kcfn_1_0_apply (cda_registration_no). Their payment steps, cda_2_0_pay_fee and cda_kcfn_2_0_payment, map it to exporter_id, from which the PAYMENT step generates the CDA payment reference (refid format fee_payment_ref).

cha.description: The Customs House Agent (CHA) company chosen for the consignment, trimmed to what an agency form reads. It is a company record like 'company', so a CHA is a company with hasCha true, and a trader may choose its own. tnsw/trade's persist_cha_task (CHA_PERSIST_WRITER) outputs it once the choice is saved, tnsw/trade/trade_workflow.json keeps it as 'trade.cha', and HSCODE_SPLIT_BUILDER puts it in every split item's payload, so an agency flow reads it at '_iter.input.cha.<field>' (see tnsw/customs/customs_workflow.json's customs_1_cusdec_submission). The trade flow requires it from trade_1b_persist_cha on, so a backend that doesn't output it parks that step (OUTPUT_MAPPING) instead of starting agency flows without it. Only the data fields listed in tnsw/trade/1b-persist_cha/transform.json's plugin_properties.cha_data_fields are copied, because the company's own data also holds credentials such as slpacmsuser_key; with none listed, data is empty. To read another field, list it there and model it under data below.

id.description: The CHA company's id, the value trade-cha-selection-flow's 'cha_company_id' resolves to, e.g. 'adam-pvt-ltd'.

name.description: Display name of the CHA company.

data.description: The CHA company's details. A field its record lacks is left out.

tin_no.description: The CHA company's TIN. Customs confirmed (#136) that the ASYCUDA declarantCode is the declarant company's TIN, not an individual CHA's number, so tnsw/customs/customs_workflow.json's customs_1_cusdec_submission prefills the CusDec's declarant code from it.

tel.description: Primary contact phone number on file for the CHA company.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email on file for the CHA company.

address.description: The CHA company's address on one line.
